lines: Prof. Shashikanth Suryanarayanan, a promoter, holds an estimated ₹966.75 crore in shares, valued at offer price; these are shares, not cash.
Promoter shares above the 20% unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago; how many shares that covers is unknown.
Minimum Promoters' Contribution stays locked until 9 Sep 2027, so the holding is not yet free to sell.
Holdings are 7,150,500 shares before the offer, and they are not selling in it; confidence is medium.
